welcome_description: I help manage your classroom with real-time moderation, engagement tracking, and learning support.
message_deleted: Your message was deleted due to a policy violation.
message_hidden: Your message was temporarily hidden for review.
warning_issued: You have received a warning for a policy violation.
warning_count: You have {{count}} warning(s). {{count_warning}} more before mute.
student_muted: You have been muted for {{duration}} hours due to {{reason}}.
mute_lifted: You have been unmuted and can send messages again.
submission_received: We received your submission for {{assignmentName}}. Thank you!
submission_confirmed: Submission confirmed. Teachers have been notified.
help_message:
I can help with:
• Answering curriculum questions
• Tracking your assignments
• Viewing engagement insights
• Understanding classroom policies
help_commands:
Available commands:
/start - Join the classroom
/help - Show this message
/status - Your engagement status
/leaderboard - Class rankings
/assignments - Your assignments
error_generic: Sorry, an error occurred. Please try again or contact your teacher.
error_network: Network error. Please check your connection.
error_invalid_input: Invalid input. Please check and try again.
session_timeout: Your session has timed out. Please restart.
engagement_moderate: Good participation. Try answering more questions.
engagement_low: Low participation. Don't be shy - join the discussion!
quality_moderate: Good message. Add more detail for better insight.
quality_low: Try to provide more detailed responses.
struggling_alert: We noticed you might be struggling. Would you like help?
help_offered: Please reach out to your teacher for assistance.
policy_spam: Messages that are promotional or repetitive
policy_harassment: Messages that are disrespectful or offensive
policy_bullying: Messages that target or demean others
policy_sexual: Messages with sexual or adult content
curriculum_not_found: I couldn't find information about that topic. Ask your teacher!
